International Publications (*: equal contribution, †: corresponding author, C: conference, J: journal)

Summary: 28 peer-reviewed international publications, including 20 top-tier AI/CV conference papers and 8 international journal papers; 10 additional manuscripts are currently under review or available as preprints. Our lab has published multiple papers in top-tier AI/CV venues.
Our publications include:
• 8 papers at CVPR (including 1 Oral, 2 Highlight)
• 3 papers at ICCV (1 Highlight, 2 Oral) and 3 papers at ECCV
• additional papers at NeurIPS, ICLR, and AAAI.
In addition, our work has appeared in leading journals such as IEEE TPAMI, IEEE TCSVT, and Neurocomputing.
